findings.element: the Animals theme line in Theme Trends chart showing spike in 2013
findings.evidence: Animals theme shows a massive spike to ~15 in 2013, then drops to near 0 in 2014 and remains low. This is a 15x+ jump from adjacent years and appears to be based on a small sample size given the dramatic drop afterward.
findings.explanation: The X-Ray panel reveals this is not a data quality issue but rather a legitimate data point. The Animals theme classification is based on 466 games total with robust methodology (AI classification from thematic keywords in game rules text). The spike appears to be real data from 2013 when animal-themed games had unusually high theoretical win rates, with the top game 'Kong 3 Even Bigger Bonus' achieving a 17.46 theo win.
findings.xray_evidence: 466 total games in the Animals theme category, AI classification method extracting from game rules HTML text, average theo win of 0.73, and a clear list of top-performing games led by 'Kong 3 Even Bigger Bonus' (17.46), 'Chicks In Vegas' (13.04), and others. The sample size is substantial and the extraction method is systematic.
findings.action: No action needed - this appears to be legitimate historical data showing that animal-themed slot games in 2013 had exceptionally high theoretical win rates, which then normalized in subsequent years.

findings.element: the Free Spins mechanic line in Mechanic Trends chart showing spike in 2013
findings.evidence: Free Spins mechanic shows a sharp spike to ~5 in 2013, then drops significantly in 2014. This appears to be an isolated peak that doesn't follow the gradual trend patterns of other mechanics.
findings.explanation: The X-Ray panel reveals critical data quality problems with the Free Spins mechanic detection. The panel shows 'No verbatim evidence captured for this feature' and relies on keyword matching against a feature taxonomy, but without source text evidence, we cannot verify the accuracy of the classification that created the 2013 spike.
findings.xray_evidence: The X-Ray shows: (1) Features identified via keyword matching against taxonomy, (2) 'No verbatim evidence captured for this feature' under the source text section, (3) Only shows one game example (Cash Eruption by IGT) but no actual text evidence of Free Spins classification, (4) 2435 games classified but no confidence score visible
findings.action: Review the keyword matching algorithm and feature taxonomy for Free Spins classification. Investigate why no source text evidence was captured, and audit the games classified as having Free Spins in 2013 to verify they actually contain this mechanic. Consider implementing stricter evidence requirements for feature classification.
